newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch SNS to buy Banque Suez Nederland. [corrected 15:57 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Dutch SNS to buy Banque Suez Nederland. [corrected 15:57 gmt]

text.p: Dutch unlisted savings bank SNS is planning to buy Banque Suez Nederland NV from Banque Indosuez, Dutch trade union FNV said on Wednesday. (Corrects by deleting reference to Banque Indosuez being unit of Cie de Suez.)
Caisse Nationale du Credit Agricole bought 51 percent of Banque Indosuez from Cie de Suez in July.
Suez Nederland has offices in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht and Eindhoven and it employs about 250 staff.
Trade union sources said they had no financial details of the deal.
Last month Dutch SNS Groep NV said it was in merger talks with unlisted Dutch insurer Reaal Groep NV.
In 1995 SNS net income from banking accounted for 73 percent of group income. Total insurance income in 1995 was 542 million guilders.
At the end of 1995 SNS Groep NV had total assets of 27.51 billion guilders and equity capital of 1.45 billion.
It employs 2,787 full-time, or equivalent staff.
Officials at Banque Indosuez in Paris were not immediately available for comment.
